t: This is the Norman Shaw South Building, in Westminster. Richard Norman Shaw designed it, and his name is on the building. He was a British architect who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s, known for his country houses and for commercial buildings. He's considered to be among the greatest of British architects, and his influence on architectural style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s. It stands as a companion to his North Building nearby.
